minutes.headline: Zoning board continued the 31 Round Road garage hearing to June 10 and asked for a new plan with the side setback kept.
minutes.summary: The board heard a special permit and dimensional variance request for a 36 by 66 storage garage at 31 Round Road. Members and two abutters objected to the size and to the five-foot side setback. The board voted to continue the hearing so the applicant can return with a fuller plan.

public_comment.topic: Opposes the garage's size and any relief from the 15 foot setback. Says other structures are already near his property line, and that the abutters were not consulted.

votes.motion: Continue the hearing to a specific date so the applicant can return with more dimensions on building B and a new proposed plan.

decisions.decision: The hearing is continued, with a new plan requested that keeps the side setback and shows the location and dimensions of the proposed garage and possibly a smaller one.
The continued hearing is set for June 10 at 7:00. The applicant is to deliver the plans several days beforehand.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted to continue the hearing on a storage garage at 31 Round Road so the applicant can return with a fuller plan.
The board asked for a new plan that keeps the side setback and shows the location and dimensions of the proposed garage, and possibly a smaller one.
The continued hearing is set for June 10 at 7:00, with plans due several days beforehand.
An abutter opposed the garage's size and any relief from the 15 foot setback, saying abutters were not consulted.

why_it_matters: The special permit and variance for this garage are undecided, so abutters on Round Road still have a chance to be heard on size and setback before the board rules.
Any approved relief from a setback rule changes how close a building can sit to a neighbor's property line.
